name: Machu Picchu Mountain
why: Higher and quieter than Huayna Picchu: the citadel, Huayna Picchu and the Urubamba loop seen from 3,082 m.
book: A Machu Picchu ticket that includes the Mountain (limited per time slot).
dangers: An hour and a half of Inca steps up; hard on the knees down.
turnaround: Respect the time on your ticket.

points.name: Machu Picchu, Mountain control
points.note: By the Guardhouse above the citadel, on the path to the Sun Gate: sign in at the Machu Picchu Mountain control.

points.name: Machu Picchu Mountain stone stairway
points.note: Endless Inca stairs through cloud forest, with orchids and drops on one side.

points.name: Machu Picchu Mountain
points.note: 3,061 m: the citadel tiny below, Huayna Picchu, and the Urubamba looping around them.
